concerns.text: FR-003 requires 1,000 zero‑preserving sign permutations for **every** window, but T008 implements only 500 permutations for a subset of 20 windows per length, leaving the majority of windows without the required permutation coverage.

Constitution VII mandates exactly 1,000 random‑sign permutations per window for null validation; the current task T008 provides only 500 permutations on selected windows, violating the constitutional null‑validation requirement.

SC-001 (CI‑coverage) has no associated task that computes or verifies the proportion of lags whose 95 % confidence interval contains zero; the task list lacks any entry addressing this success criterion.
Task T003 carries an invalid tag `[USx?]` which does not correspond to any defined user story, creating a stale reference.
